title: Missed connection on one booking, tapered delay
narrative: My first flight was late so I missed my connection in Doha and got in to Sydney the next morning. I was told the delay only counts on the leg that was late.

documents.content:
BOOKING MT5590 — Passenger: D. FERREIRA (adult)
Carrier: Meridian Transcontinental (MT)
MT119  MAD 11 Nov 2026 14:20  ->  DOH 11 Nov 2026 23:10
MT402  DOH 12 Nov 2026 01:55  ->  SYD 12 Nov 2026 21:30
BOTH SEGMENTS ON THIS SINGLE BOOKING REFERENCE.
Great-circle distance MAD-SYD (origin to final destination): 17,680 km.
Status: CONFIRMED.
BOARDING PASS MT119 11NOV2026 — FERREIRA/D — seat 21A — boarded 14:05Z

MT OPS LOG — MT119 / 11NOV2026
Status: DELAYED 02:35 departure
Cause code: ROT-INB
Cause text: Late inbound aircraft. Inbound MT118 delayed by MT ground handling shortfall at MAD. No weather or ATC restriction.
Consequence: 14 passengers misconnected at DOH onto MT404.

SYD ARRIVALS
Originally ticketed arrival (MT402): 12 Nov 2026 21:30 local
Passenger FERREIRA/D rebooked onto MT404, actual on-blocks 13 Nov 2026 01:40 local
Delay at final destination: 4h 10m

derivation: S2.3 both segments on a single booking reference -> missed connection qualifies
S2.2 delay measured at final destination SYD, not at DOH
S3.2(e) late inbound aircraft, inbound delay itself carrier-controlled
S5.4 4h 10m is at or over 3h30m but under 5 hours -> 50% taper -> 375 units
